_comment: Performance budget checked by `npm run perf` (all values are maximums).
'*' applies to every setup; a setup's own entry overrides it per metric.
Targets come from CLAUDE.md: 60 fps on this M1 Max in Chrome and Safari; 30 fps minimum on older hardware
(chromium-lowend = CPU throttled 4x, a rough stand-in). Draw calls / triangles leave headroom for Steps 5-7 art.
Frame times are display-capped (8.3 ms at 120 Hz, 16.7 ms at 60 Hz); cpuMs is our own work per frame.
p95FrameMs 20 (not 16.7): WebKit reports frame times in whole ms, so a steady 60 fps reads 16-18 ms.
tiles.finalize* = main-thread time to turn one built tile into meshes (incl. texture upload); must stay well under one 60 Hz frame. Measured 2-8 ms; noisy in Chrome.
